summary: Tests-writing run for issue #5 (generated OpenAPI Swift client). Added permanent unit tests that pin the vendored OpenAPI document contract and exercise the generated client against stubbed server responses, plus the contract-delta record. Red phase verified: 14/14 new tests fail at this PR head for exactly the two missing artifacts (vendored spec document, generated ColorMatchingOpenAPI module). Compile/runtime validity of the generated-client tests was proven end to end in a scratch SwiftPM package: real swift-openapi-generator 1.13.1 output + the repo test file => all 10 stubbed-transport tests green; a conforming vendored document => all 13 coverage tests green; updated APIClientTests remain green against the current hand-written client (Linux, Swift 6.1, with FoundationNetworking shim in scratch copies only).
